long_biography.plain_text:
At Juvo Technologies, founder Bryan Schroder paired telecommunications consulting with software for controlling the complicated service estates of multi-location businesses. The company's Simplicity platform brought wireless and fixed-line inventory, tickets, orders and invoices into one application. Alongside the platform, the firm handled vendor orders, contract negotiation, inventory, invoices and reporting.

Juvo extended that model by acquiring Vendorin from its Omaha founder. The payments team spent four years developing a supplier-enrolment network that could move accounts-payable work from paper to electronic methods. After Corcentric bought Vendorin, Schroder remained at Juvo as manager and chief executive. Its current work covers technology assets, connectivity, software subscriptions and managed business support.
